title: Juicy Garlicky Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A romantic Venezuelan dish featuring turmeric powder and garlicky flavors, perfect for a special dinner, this recipe is sugar free friendly and offers a delicious twist on traditional chicken skewers.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the chicken slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a bowl, mix together turmeric powder, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika to create a marinade.
Brush the marinade onto both sides of the chicken skewers.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
